title: Blake Berking Selected to Represent Samoa at FIBA U15 Oceania Cup
excerpt: Congratulations to Rosehill College student Blake Berking, who has been selected to represent Samoa at the FIBA U15 Oceania Cup!
body:
A big congratulations to Rosehill College student Blake, who has been selected to represent Samoa at the FIBA U15 Oceania Cup!

Standing at 6ft 9, Blake is passionate about basketball, and this is an exciting opportunity to develop his skills and gain valuable international experience.

Blake has had a fantastic first year at Rosehill College, recently receiving two Principal’s Awards. We are proud of his achievements and the young man he is becoming.

These photos capture Blake in action at HoopNation last weekend, doing what he loves!

Congratulations, Blake! We look forward to following your journey as you represent Samoa on the international stage. 👏
